items.title: Build the ContextRail MVP
acceptance: Repository validates its own documents and state
Bootstrap, routing, continuation, and measurement commands pass tests
Optional Throughline preparation and verification are reproducible and safe

items.title: Choose the ContextRail open-source license
acceptance: LICENSE matches the maintainer's publication intent

items.title: Create and configure the GitHub Template Repository
acceptance: Remote ownership, visibility, name, and template setting are confirmed
nextSteps: Create the remote only after explicit approval

items.title: Establish a measured ContextRail baseline
acceptance: Comparable task protocol and provenance are documented
No unsupported performance claim is made
nextSteps: Collect local records after the CLI is in use

items.title: Adopt existing repository authority and state safely
acceptance: Existing authority and state remain user-owned and unmodified
Only three ContextRail metadata files are planned and owned
Reference state and recursive authority mappings pass tests and Security dry-run
nextSteps: Use the documented apply command after reviewing a repository-specific adoption config

items.title: Publish and install ContextRail v0.1.0
acceptance: The installable 0.1.0 package passes isolated smoke tests
The public GitHub Template Repository and v0.1.0 release exist
The global CLI is installed from the verified release artifact
Security check, route, and continue remain read-only and pass
nextSteps: Use the immutable v0.1.0 release as the installation baseline

items.title: Add opt-in Codex context automation hooks
acceptance: UserPromptSubmit injects bounded route or continuation context only for enabled projects
Stop performs a non-blocking read-only ContextRail check
Install and uninstall preserve Throughline and unrelated hooks with receipt and hash guards
Automation config changes are plan-first, ownership-guarded, and transactional
Temporary-HOME, regression, package, and read-only real-HOME diagnostics pass for v0.2.0
nextSteps: Use the immutable v0.2.0 release and review dry runs before any user-level or project-level apply

items.title: Deliver cross-platform end-to-end installation
acceptance: A clean macOS, Windows, or Linux computer can follow the README to install the ContextRail CLI and choose a full or explicitly reduced setup profile
The primary human quickstart uses one stable-name GitHub Release install command followed by interactive contextrail setup, while Codex and CI retain explicit dry-run and apply commands

The default full setup installs or reuses a verified Codex-compatible Throughline, configures ContextRail Hooks, and enables the selected new or existing project through reviewed dry-run and apply boundaries
GitHub Releases publish immutable ContextRail and Throughline artifacts plus a pinned manifest and SHA-256 evidence
The byte-identical ContextRail release-candidate tarball is published publicly under next, with later releases using OIDC Trusted Publishing and no long-lived npm token
Packed-artifact setup and Hook coexistence tests pass on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows CI
Windows live Codex validation remains explicitly pending until the user executes the supplied pilot checklist
nextSteps: Update the existing Windows project in place to 0.3.0-rc.5, verify live context plus capture/restore/handoff, and retain the Windows live gate for latest
